title: Pieces and weight over the caps (100001 pieces, 1000001 lbs)
why: Ruling 12 caps: pieces 0 to 100000, weight up to 1000000. A unit mix-up (grams as lbs) blows past them.

pickup.address: 1200 Example Pkwy, Elk Grove Village, IL, 60007

errors.message: pieces must be a whole number from 0 to 100000.
errors.fix: Send pieces as a whole number from 0 to 100000.

errors.message: weight.value must be a number from 0 to 1000000.
errors.fix: Send weight.value as a number from 0 to 1000000.
